# T.E.R.M. Edu

> India's #1 Entrepreneurship Learning Management System — Stop Studying. Start Building.

T.E.R.M. Edu (The Academic Atelier) is India's premier platform for entrepreneurship education. It combines an AI-powered entrance examination, live expert-led classes, self-paced business courses, mentorship, and startup incubation — all in one platform.

## Core URLs

- [Homepage](https://app.termedu.in/) — Main platform, login, onboarding
- [Pricing & Plans](https://app.termedu.in/pricing) — Starter, Growth, Premium plan details
- [TEET Exam](https://app.termedu.in/teet) — AI-powered entrance test
- [Login](https://app.termedu.in/login) — Student, lecturer, admin login

## What is T.E.R.M. Edu?

T.E.R.M. Edu is an entrepreneurship-focused LMS (Learning Management System) built for India. It is NOT a general education platform — every course, class, and program is designed to help students build real businesses and startups.

Key differentiators:
- **TEET** (T.E.R.M. Edu Entrance Test): An AI-powered conversational entrance examination. An AI interviewer named "Priya" conducts the test. Passing TEET unlocks Growth and Premium plans.
- **Live Classes**: Expert mentors (startup founders, business leaders) teach live sessions.
- **Self-paced Courses**: Entrepreneurship, business skills, financial literacy, leadership.
- **Android App**: Available as an Android APK, serving students at app.termedu.in.

## User Roles

1. **Student** — takes TEET, joins courses, attends live sessions, submits projects
2. **Lecturer** — creates and manages courses, hosts live sessions, evaluates projects
3. **Admin** — manages users, content, plans, and platform configuration

## Plans

| Plan     | Price     | TEET Required | Key Access |
|----------|-----------|---------------|------------|
| Starter  | Free      | No            | Self-paced courses only |
| Growth   | Paid      | Yes           | Live classes + course bundles |
| Premium  | Paid      | Yes (top score) | All access + mentorship + incubation |

## Key Features

- AI-powered TEET entrance examination (conversational, conducted by AI "Priya")
- Live online classes with real expert mentors
- Self-paced entrepreneurship course library
- Real-time push notifications
- Project submission and evaluation
- Startup incubation and mentorship track
- Secure OTP-based login (email verification)
- Server-side persistent sessions (30-day login)
- Works on Web (all browsers) and Android
